newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Rate unchanged at Tunisian treasury auction.
newsitem.headline: Rate unchanged at Tunisian treasury auction.

text.p: The Tunisian Treasury raised 33 million dinars at its weekly auction of treasury bills dated March 25, and repaid maturing paper totalling 49.1 million dinars.
The issue of 52-week paper was at a 6.8750 percent coupon rate, unchanged from its level the previous week.
Banks bid for 288 million dinars for 13-, 26-, 52-week paper at between 6.8375 and 7.000 percent. The Treasury issued only 52-week paper.
